region.title: Where are you based?
region.subtitle: Yorik adapts dates, currency and document numbering to your country.
region.bonusText: if you finish setup as a business, Yorik will set up legally-compliant invoice numbering for your country automatically — you can change everything later.

welcome.title: Hi {{name}}, welcome to Yorik
welcome.body: A 2-minute setup so Yorik knows who you are. We'll personalize letters, invoices, and chat replies — and you can skip anything you don't want to share right now.

diagnostics.title: May Yorik tell its makers when something goes wrong?
diagnostics.subtitle: Everything is off. Each switch is a separate yes, you can change them any time in Settings → Privacy, and Yorik never sends mail, documents or messages — people become numbers before anything leaves this computer.

address.privacyNote: Stays on this machine. Yorik only uses it for documents you create.

business.personalText: Letters, government forms, family stuff. No invoice numbering needed.
business.businessText: Send invoices and quotes. Yorik sets up sequential numbering, ZUGFeRD when needed.
business.name: Business name

storage.text: Yorik's databases (calendar, contacts, chat history) are small and stay on the internal disk. Photos and document scans can grow into hundreds of GB — relocate them to an external SSD if you have one. You can skip this step and decide later in Settings → Storage.

backup.text: Set a passphrase + a target now and Yorik will auto-snapshot every night. You can change any of this later in Settings → Backup, but a Yorik without backups is a Yorik one disk away from losing your family's data.

tour.welcomeBody: Yorik is your family and business OS — calendar, email, documents, photos, chat. Everything runs locally on this machine. No cloud, no subscriptions, no data leaves the house.
tour.llmOk: Your local model <mono>{{model}}</mono> is running and ready. Voice + chat will work out of the box.
tour.llmDown: Local LLM isn't reachable. Start your llama-swap (or similar) container at <mono>localhost:8080</mono>, or point Yorik elsewhere in Settings → LLM.
tour.demoLoadedBody: A week of events, a few tasks, a couple of bills are loaded. You can remove them any time in Settings → Demo.
tour.demoBody: Want a populated app to click around in? One click loads a week of fake events, tasks, and bills (with a friendly note in the bell). Removable in one click from Settings → Demo.
tour.emailDoneBody: You've already wired up an email account. Yorik will summarise, triage, and auto-draft replies for you.
tour.emailBody: Connecting an IMAP account lets Yorik triage bills, propose calendar slots, and draft replies. Optional — you can do this later.
tour.tryBody: Tap one to send it to Yorik. The mic in the bottom-right does the same thing by voice.
tour.installIos: On iPhone Safari: tap the Share button, then 'Add to Home Screen'.
tour.installAndroid: On Android Chrome: tap the ⋮ menu, then 'Install app' or 'Add to Home screen'.
tour.installOther: On your phone's browser: open this URL, then use Share / menu → 'Add to Home Screen' so Yorik opens like a native app.
tour.tailscaleAlready: You're already on a Tailscale URL — open the same address (<mono>{{host}}</mono>) on your phone.
tour.tailscaleBefore: Yorik is reachable across your devices via
tour.tailscaleAfter: (free for personal use, no port-forwarding). Install it on this box and on your phone, then visit

setup.fallbackNote: Save this password — Yorik uses it for Paperless and you'll need it for direct Paperless logins.
setup.fallbackBody: Your chosen password didn't meet Paperless's complexity rules, so we generated a stronger one for it. You'll need this for direct logins to the Paperless web UI. Yorik uses it automatically.
setup.fallbackFooter: Stored encrypted on this machine. Yorik won't show it again, so keep it somewhere safe.
setup.title: Set up your Yorik
setup.subtitleReset: The host operator issued you a reset link. Pick a new password and you're back in. Your data is untouched.
setup.subtitleInvite: You've been invited to your own private Yorik. Pick the credentials you'll use to sign in — only you will have access to this household's data.
setup.subtitle: First run — create the owner account. You'll be the admin, with full access to settings and other users you invite later.
setup.alphaNote: Alpha note: 8 characters is the current minimum. Beta will require stronger passwords (longer, common-password check). Yorik holds your real personal data — pick something solid now so you don't have to reset later.
setup.footer: This password is hashed with bcrypt and stored only on this machine.

login.subtitle: Sign in to your Yorik
login.footer: Local-first · your data stays on this machine
